title: Lead page: a separate Workers tab
question: Workers leave the agents sidebar and move to their lead's page, in a Workers tab beside Todos. The sidebar keeps one summary line per lead. Clicking a worker opens its stream with a link back to the lead. Both streams replay the real rondo lead and its Live Activities worker at 13:24 UTC on 6 Nov.

options.label: Workers tab on the lead page, leads-only sidebar
options.thesis: The sidebar lists leads only, each with a worker summary line. The right column has Todos and Workers tabs; Workers groups the lead's workers by Waiting on you, Working, Held by the lead and Finished. A worker opens in the conversation column with a back button and a 'Worker of <lead>' link.
options.viewport: 1600 × 1000 at the live edge; also 1280 × 800, 900 × 800, the top of the lead stream, the Todos tab, and the worker view at all three sizes.
options.risk: A held worker and a worker waiting on the owner look the same in today's data; the Held group needs a new signal.
